messages:
Devon R: Heads-up — customer ACME (acct AC-3342) reports client disconnects mid-stream when switching WiFi -> cellular on iOS. They see a partial JSON chunk and then the socket closes. Happening reliably for long responses (~60+ tokens). Any immediate ideas?

Maya K: Ugh. Do we have SDK + app version, and any server logs? tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-sre :eyes:

Support Bot: INC-2026 created for AC-3342 — priority P1.

Devon R: App: iOS 1.8.2, Redwood SDK 0.12.4 (swift). Repro steps customer provided: 1) start streaming response, 2) while streaming toggle WiFi off -> cellular, 3) stream yields one or two partial SSE chunks then connection drops. They attached client logs snippet: 

```
2026-02-18 14:12:05.243 MyApp[12345:67890] StreamEvent: data: {"id":123, "choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello"}}]}
2026-02-18 14:12:12.892 MyApp[12345:67890] Network change: WiFi -> Cellular (SSID lost)
2026-02-18 14:12:13.105 MyApp[12345:67890] URLSessionTask finished with error: (error code: -1005) "The network connection was lost."
```

Samir P: Is the client seeing a TCP RST or just a soft EOF? Also need the exact response headers from the stream. Could be NAT timeout or client-side TCP reset on network change. Can you ask for a packet-level capture or `/dev/log`?

Tina L: We should try to repro locally on a device with hotspot switch. On iOS the OS sometimes tears down sockets when switching networks — app-level reconnect is required. For streaming, SDK should treat a mid-stream disconnect as recoverable and attempt ranged resume using Last-Event-ID or event stream reconnect semantics. Does our SDK do that?

Maya K: SDK currently retries at the request level but we don't resume partial responses. For SSE we rely on client to reconnect and re-request with session_id in the prompt to continue. Workaround: set short keepalive pings from client every 15s to keep NAT pinhole open during the handoff.

Devon R: Customer asked if there's a server-side flag to help. They'd prefer less code changes.

Samir P: Server side: check proxy (envoy) idle timeouts and upstream TCP keepalive. If proxy closes idle connection on handoff or sees long pause it may return 200 then tear down. Need envoy access logs around the time. Suggest increasing `stream_idle_timeout` and enabling `tcp_keepalive` on the worker VMs. I'll ping @eng-sre.

Alex M: I'll pull proxy logs for INC-2026 window. Current front-proxy config: `idle_timeout: 60s`, `proxy_read_timeout: 120s`, tcp_keepalive=15s. If the device toggles networks, there's a 7-12s blackhole while interface resets — NAT mapping can be lost, causing connection reset.

Devon R: Customer also saw partial JSON where final chunk missing and then client reports -1005. They worried about billing for partial responses. Any notes on how we bill?

Maya K: Billing note: we bill on completed token delivery for hosted API; partial aborts can get credited case-by-case. For support response, include the request_id and timestamp.

Tina L: Quick repro instructions for ENG: 1) Use iPhone with app build 1.8.2, 2) Start streaming a ~200 token response (use large prompt), 3) While streaming, toggle WiFi off -> cellular; observe socket close within 1-2s. Also try with hotspot switch (create separate NAT) to see if NAT pinhole loss causes immediate RST.

Samir P: For debugging append this header to stream call to get server debug id: `X-Debug-Trace: inc-2026`. Also capture envoy access log line: `REQID {request_id} upstream_status {status} bytes_sent {n}`.

Devon R: Customer provided server request_id: rq-0a1b2c3d. Alex — can you search logs for that?

Alex M: Found it — envoy shows a 200 then connection close at 14:12:13. Upstream returned partial body and then `downstream_connection_termination`. I'll attach envoy snippet to the ticket.

Maya K: Short-term workaround we can recommend to customer: 1) enable client keepalive pings every 15s; 2) on disconnect, automatically reconnect and continue the session by re-sending the prompt with last received tokens (or session_id). Example client-side pseudo: 

```
if stream.disconnect:
  resume_with(session_id, last_token_index)
```

Tina L: Long-term: we should add a resumable streaming protocol on the SDK layer or last-event-id based resume token that lets server stitch continuations so customers don't have to duplicate prompt state. I'll file a product story.

Samir P: Action items: 1) eng-sre (Alex) collect envoy logs + conn-level metrics (in progress). 2) eng-runtime (Samir) instrument stream resume/error codes and add advisory for SDK keepalive. 3) support to send repro app binary to eng if needed. Owner: Samir P. ETA: 48h for initial triage.

Devon R: Thanks. I'll relay workaround steps to customer and ask for packet capture if they're able. Please cc on updates. :thumbsup:

Support Bot: INC-2026 updated: assignees [Samir P, Alex M], status: Investigation.
